_comment: The project's optimization mandate (docs/process/optimization.md, 'Decision rights'). Copy to docs/process/optimization.local.json and set the values with the owner; without that file analysis is allowed and no trial starts. Read by scripts/process/optimize.py: `max_pilot_days` (a trial's `until` may lie at most this far ahead when it starts) and `steward_may` (rights the owner delegates: `start` a trial, `roll-back`, `reject`, `adopt`; stopping is everybody's and needs no right). The other keys are the mandate's text for whoever designs and judges a trial — goals in priority order above the floors, the floors no trial may lower, the optimization budget as a share of the measured tokens and execution time over the window, and the starting points to calibrate against the baseline. Changing this file is the owner's decision (lowering a floor, widening the steward's rights, raising a budget) and is reviewed like any process configuration.
floors: no gate disabled or bypassed by a trial
no tier lowered and no review independence reduced
acceptance criteria and the Definition of Done unchanged
no change to security boundaries or data without its own Tier 3 review
